RETRIEVE.review_focus: Definitions, units, sign conventions and model conditions must be reconstructed from defining features rather than keyword familiarity.

misconception_patterns.wrong_idea: A familiar quantity name is recalled with the wrong sign, unit, or applicability condition.
misconception_patterns.diagnostic_prompt: Ask for the unit/sign/condition and a reason, not only the label.
misconception_patterns.repair: Re-anchor the fact to its physical definition and the condition under which it is true.

EXPLAIN.review_focus: Require a physical mechanism or causal relation, not a restatement of the observed motion or a bare formula.

misconception_patterns.wrong_idea: A formula is quoted as the explanation without naming the physical mechanism.
misconception_patterns.diagnostic_prompt: Change one physical condition and ask what changes and why.
misconception_patterns.repair: Name the governing interaction/principle and connect each causal step to the observed outcome.

APPLY.review_focus: Check model conditions and variable/sign mapping before routine computation.

misconception_patterns.wrong_idea: A correct formula is applied with the wrong body, axis, sign, or validity condition.
misconception_patterns.diagnostic_prompt: Ask the learner to name the body/axis/model condition before substituting.
misconception_patterns.repair: Map the physical quantities to the declared model first, then execute and independently check.

MODEL.review_focus: The decisive work is selecting the physical system, model/law and assumptions; pre-attempt support must not name the winning model.

misconception_patterns.wrong_idea: The learner selects the law suggested by a keyword without checking system boundaries or assumptions.
misconception_patterns.diagnostic_prompt: Offer two plausible models and ask which stated condition rules one out.
misconception_patterns.repair: Choose the system and model by matching assumptions/invariants to the situation, then state what the model does not claim.

REPRESENT.review_focus: Protect meaning across diagram/vector/component/graph translations; signs, axes, slope/area meaning and shared time are invariants.

misconception_patterns.wrong_idea: The learner copies visual shape while changing sign, scale, direction, or the physical quantity represented.
misconception_patterns.diagnostic_prompt: Ask for one invariant that must agree in both representations before drawing the target.
misconception_patterns.repair: State the invariant, map labelled physical quantities one by one, then round-trip check the translation.

SYNTHESIZE.review_focus: Make dependencies/shared events visible while leaving the bridge that coordinates multiple physical ideas to the learner.

misconception_patterns.wrong_idea: Subproblems are solved independently even though they share a time, state, constraint, or conserved quantity.
misconception_patterns.diagnostic_prompt: Ask which quantity or event is shared by two parts of the problem.
misconception_patterns.repair: Establish the shared state/constraint first, propagate it through the dependent models, then verify by an independent invariant.

JUSTIFY.review_focus: A derivation or experimental inference must state the physical warrant and its conditions, not only algebraic equivalence.

misconception_patterns.wrong_idea: Algebra that reaches the target expression is treated as proof that the physical model applies.
misconception_patterns.diagnostic_prompt: Ask which physical assumption licenses the first non-algebraic step.
misconception_patterns.repair: Separate physical assumptions from algebra, justify each model-dependent step, and test the conclusion against dimensions or a boundary case.
